title: Lead - Diagnostics & Health Innovation Hub
jobDescription:
Typical Accountabilities

• Ensure that Diagnostic Manager and diagnostic liaison objectives are met at a national level by setting clear goals in alignment with organizational priorities.

• Develop a strategy for adoption of companion diagnostic testing, including defining metrics to measure success.

• Identify and build relationships with key scientific stakeholders such as laboratory decision makers, anatomical and molecular pathologists, and other healthcare professionals.

• Provide approved, relevant educational material on diagnostics to enhance understanding and competency among clinical laboratory leaders and their staff.

• Deliver highly technical presentations on data related to diagnostics and testing.

• Educate on the importance of diagnostic quality assurance (QA) programs to ensure high standards in testing processes.

• Partner with diagnostic companies, lab networks, and healthcare professionals to identify and resolve barriers to diagnostic testing, driving accessibility and efficiency.

• Develop tailored strategies that support and educate on appropriate diagnostic testing practices.

• Align actions with broader business plans and assess the impact of external market trends and regulatory changes on organizational strategies to adapt accordingly.

• Work alongside customers and sales teams in the field to influence customer perceptions and reinforce the value of the brand portfolio.

• Focus on delivering on high-impact opportunities by implementing customer-specific approaches based upon their needs and preferences.

• Demonstrate exceptional awareness of both situational contexts and individual motivations, using this insight to influence stakeholders effectively and drive results.

• Use robust analytical methods to identify issues and opportunities early, integrating new perspectives to refine solutions and strategies.

• Anticipate and eliminate potential obstacles to ensure that teams can focus on delivering impactful results efficiently.

• Lead, coach, and develop Diagnostics Managers and liaisons, defining clear roles, responsibilities and business objectives, and fostering professional growth and engagement.

• Adhere to compliance standards, including the AZ Code of Conduct, Market Policy Handbook, and other regulatory guidelines, ensuring the highest ethical accountability in all professional activities.

Qualifications and Skills

  • Essential: Undergraduate life sciences/medical degree required (advanced degree preferred); Minimum of 5 years of experience in diagnostic or pharmaceuticals; Proven management experience in field; Strong teamwork and collaboration skills; Excellent communication skills with the ability to work cross-functionally with market-based and global partners; Ability to identify strategies with the greatest business impact, formulate appropriate business plans, and lead teams to execute them; Demonstrated leadership and communication competencies; Experience in managing budgets; Thorough understanding of customer segments and market dynamics within the diagnostic area; Ability to lead, manage, and develop staff; Previous successful experience in customer support environments; Demonstrated presentation and negotiation skills.

  • Desirable: Proven track record of strategic thinking, judgment, and influencing skills; Demonstrated ability to influence national internal teams and customers to ensure a strong focus with excellent execution; Proven experience in developing compelling business cases; Extensive experience in a launch environment; Strong leadership attributes to set direction, generate commitment, balance short- and long-term needs, and constructively resolve issues; Proven ability to demonstrate effective cross-functional leadership; Advanced Degree PHD,MD or MBA and/or prior experience in multiple functions

  • Internal: Senior management team; Business leaders; Cross functional partners.

  • External: Diagnostic partners; Regulatory bodies.

title: Medico Marketing Excellence Executive
jobDescription:
About Astra Zeneca

Astra Zeneca is a global, science-led, patient-focused biopharmaceutical company that focuses on the discovery, development and commercialization of prescription medicines for some of the world’s most serious diseases. But we’re more than one of the world’s leading pharmaceutical companies.

Introduction to role

This role drives end-to-end support to medical affairs team & VEEVA-led events, from initiation and implementation through to closure, ensuring all associated costs are accurately assembled and reconciled. It involves regular tracking and monitoring of VEEVA events for strict adherence to process and documentation standards, with timely updates shared across teams. Daily collaboration includes Medical, Marketing, as well as MME/MMSE teams, IT, Event Desk, Compliance, Sales, Business Units, Legal and other internal divisions to keep activities aligned and compliant. The role safeguards zero breaches in documentation and processes, upholds Astra Zeneca policies, and proactively raises flags where requirements or risks are identified. Ready to help develop how events are delivered with rigour and impact?

Accountabilities

Lead the full lifecycle of VEEVA-led events, ensuring accurate set-up, execution and closure in line with internal procedures and timelines.

Monitor event status and documentation on a regular basis, identifying gaps early and driving corrective actions to maintain compliance.

Coordinate closely with Medical, Marketing, MME/MMSE, Compliance, Legal, Purchase & Event Desk, Sales, IS/IT, HR and Finance to secure approvals, information and support.

Track and reconcile all event-related costs, ensuring transparency, completeness and alignment with budget expectations.

Maintain meticulous records and audit-ready documentation for all assigned events and activities.

Act as a point of contact for process queries related to VEEVA events, helping colleagues navigate systems and requirements.

Call out potential compliance issues or process deviations promptly, supporting root-cause analysis and preventive improvements.

Contribute to continuous improvement of event processes, tools and templates, leveraging IT systems for efficiency and consistency.

Support training or onboarding activities related to VEEVA event processes for relevant stakeholders.

Champion adherence to Astra Zeneca policies and standards in every interaction and decision.

Essential Skills/Experience

  • Scientific background
  • Excellent project managerial skills
  • Good collaboration skills with multiple stakeholders
  • Proficiency in spoken and written English
  • MS Office Applications - should have reasonably very good command

Desirable Skills/Experience

2+ years in pharmaceutical business in commercially aware business roles is preferable

Experience of optimal use of IT systems and process improvement.

Why Astra Zeneca?

At Astra Zeneca we’re dedicated to being a Great Place to Work. Where you are empowered to push the boundaries of science and unleash your entrepreneurial spirit. There’s no better place to make a difference to medicine, patients and society. An inclusive culture that champions diversity and collaboration, and always committed to lifelong learning, growth and development. We’re on an exciting journey to pioneer the future of healthcare.

You can find alternative messaging to use in the ‘Global Talent Attraction Story messaging’ section of the Global Playbook on the Employer Brand Portal - try to use other examples in order to make it different for candidates!

So, what’s next?

  • Are you already imagining yourself joining our team? Good, because we can’t wait to hear from you.
  • Are you ready to bring new ideas and fresh thinking to the table? Brilliant! We have one seat available and we hope it’s yours.

title: Lead Consultant - Knowledge graph expert
jobDescription:
Job Title: Lead Consultant - Knowledge graph expert

Introduction to ROLE:

Are you ready to turn knowledge graphs and agentic AI into production products that accelerate how medicines reach patients? Do you thrive on moving from idea to working software, shipping secure, reliable systems that reason, plan and act across complex data and tools?

In this hands-on role, you will lead the design and build of Gen AI assistants and agentic solutions that help global supply chain teams plan, source and deliver with greater speed and confidence. You will create end-to-end applications that combine RAG and Graph RAG with full-stack engineering and deploy them on AWS—bridging pioneering AI with the realities of enterprise operations to deliver measurable impact.

You will join a small, multi-functional team where product, data science and engineering sit side by side. Here, you will turn high-value supply chain problems into scalable AI products, moving quickly from Po C to production while building reusable patterns the wider organization can adopt.

Accountabilities:

  • Product Strategy and Alignment: Translate priority supply chain problems into product roadmaps and technical strategies that deliver measurable outcomes (cycle-time reduction, service-level improvements, transparency for decision-makers).
  • Agentic AI Development: Design and implement agents that plans, reason and act using tool/function calling and orchestration frameworks (e.g., Lang Graph, Crew AI, Auto Gen or Bedrock Agents), including multi-agent workflows where they contribute.
  • End-to-End LLM Applications: Build robust RAG and Graph RAG pipelines—embeddings, vector search, retrieval and re-ranking, prompt orchestration and evaluation—to ground responses in trustworthy data and supply chain context.
  • Knowledge Graph Integration: Model supply chain entities and relationships; integrate graph-based retrieval to power reasoning and traceability across processes and data sources, enabling better root-cause analysis and proactive interventions.
  • Full-Stack Engineering: Develop back-end services and APIs (Python/Fast-API or Node.js) and front-end applications (React/Next.js, Type Script) that put AI insights and actions in the hands of users.
  • Cloud Deployment and Operations: Ship to production on AWS (Bedrock, Sage Maker, Lambda, ECS/EKS, Open-Search, S3), with security, observability and cost-awareness built in from day one.
  • Move use cases from Po C to services that are resilient and monitored. Define SLIs and SLOs. Implement testing and CI/CD. Use data to guide improvements.
  • Reusable Components and Standards: Codify common patterns, guardrails and libraries across teams to accelerate delivery and ensure consistent quality.
  • Stake-holder Partnership: Work closely with product, engineering, data science and supply chain leaders to prioritize, pilot and scale solutions; communicate trade-offs and guide adoption of AI driven ways of working.

Essential Skills/Experience:

  • Strong full-stack software engineering — front-end (React / Next.js, Type Script) and back-end (Python / Fast API or Node.js), building and shipping production APIs and apps.
  • Hands-on experience building agentic AI solutions — LLM agents that use tool calling / function calling, planning / reasoning loops, and orchestration frameworks (e.g. Lang Graph, Bedrock Agents); multi-agent design a plus.
  • Hands-on Gen AI / LLM experience: RAG (embeddings, vector databases, chunking, retrieval, re-ranking) and exposure to Graph RAG.
  • Solid AWS experience (preferred cloud) — e.g. Bedrock, Sage Maker, Lambda, containers, Open-Search.
  • Comfortable across the full SDLC in Agile teams; good communication.
  • Product/Project Management experience in Data, Analytics & AI solutions
  • Bachelor's - degree in IT, Computer Science, Data Analytics, or related field.

Desirable Skills/Experience:

  • Master's - Degree, M.B.A, or Ph.d in a relevant field
  • Knowledge Graph experience with Neo4j or Amazon Neptune (graph modelling, Cypher / Gremlin) — a strong plus, not required; we'll help you upskill.
  • Lang Chain / Langsmith, LLM evaluation and guardrails, MLOps / LLMOps and Observability.
  • Prompt-engineering fluency and awareness of current Gen AI tooling.
  • Pharma / regulated-industry or large-enterprise experience.

Why Astra Zeneca:

Join a global community of technologists and data experts working shoulder to shoulder with scientists and supply chain leaders to reshape how medicines are made and delivered. We are investing heavily in modern platforms and AI, pairing bold ambition with the support to experiment, learn fast and scale what works. Expect unexpected teams in the same room unleashing inventive ideas, a thoughtful culture that values kindness alongside drive, and clear line of sight from your code to patient outcomes. You will have room to own outcomes, tackle complex challenges and grow your craft while helping an entire enterprise become truly data-led.

Call to Action:

If you want to build agentic, graph-powered AI that ships to production and moves life-changing medicines faster to patients, we’d love to see how you’ll lead the way!

title: Senior Product Manager – Enterprise DevOps Platforms
jobDescription:
Job Title: Senior Product Manager – Enterprise Dev Ops Platforms

GCL: E

Introduction to ROLE:

Are you ready to build and scale a comprehensive Dev Ops infrastructure that 20,000–30,000 users depend on to move life-changing science to patients faster! This is your opportunity to set the strategy for tools and services that power developer productivity, accelerate delivery, and raise the quality of decision-making across the company. You will feel the sponsorship behind the mission and see the impact of your choices recognized at the highest levels.

You will lead with both vision and execution—bridging business priorities, user experience, engineering capability, oversight, and organizational standards to build a cohesive platform backbone. Working with guides in software development, cybersecurity, system build, and data, you will align Jira, Confluence, Git Hub, Git Hub Copilot and adjacent services into a secure, scalable, AI-enabled ecosystem. Do you thrive on connecting strategic direction with pragmatic delivery to unlock productivity at scale?

Accountabilities:

  • Portfolio Product Strategy and Vision: Define and drive the product strategy, vision, and roadmap across the enterprise Dev Ops platform portfolio, aligning business priorities, engineering needs, platform evolution, and enterprise architecture standards to deliver measurable outcomes.
  • Team Leadership and Development: Lead and develop Product Owners across multiple products; set direction, clarify accountabilities, set objectives, coach, handle performance, and build a high-performing, outcome-focused culture.
  • Connected Platform Ecosystem: Manage Jira, Confluence, Git Hub, Git Hub Copilot and related Dev Ops services as an integrated ecosystem, not isolated tools; align roadmaps, priorities, and service improvements to support a coherent enterprise strategy.
  • Portfolio Prioritization and Direction: Run portfolio-level prioritization that balances business value, user needs, adoption, operational sustainability, security, compliance, and long-term platform health; translate strategy into clear direction and support Product Owners in delivering agreed outcomes.
  • Enterprise-Scale Adoption: Drive large-scale adoption and effective usage across 20,000–30,000 users; remove barriers, improve usability and accessibility, and partner with engineering coaches, platform teams, and business collaborators to increase engagement and realized value.
  • Ensure platforms are delivered as scalable, supportable, and maintainable enterprise-grade services. Align these services with policies, governance, and the overall organizational system build. Promote standardization, consolidation, and simplification to reduce fragmentation.
  • Security by Build and Governance: Embed security-by-design, Dev Sec Ops practices, least privilege principles, and regulatory expectations across the portfolio; ensure secure defaults and appropriate governance in partnership with engineering, security, architecture, and compliance.
  • Senior Collaborator Engagement and Influence: Engage senior leaders across business and technology to understand priorities, reconcile differing needs, and influence decisions; act as a senior extension business, product, engineering, and governance.

Essential Skills/Experience:

  • The successful candidate will demonstrate significant experience in a product management leadership role such as Senior Product Manager, Lead Product Manager, Product Lead, or a similar position within a technical, platform, or enterprise tooling environment.
  • They will bring strong expertise in Dev Ops, Dev Sec Ops, CI/CD, developer workflows, and enterprise platform product management, together with experience operating across a sophisticated collaborator environment.
  • They will also have confirmed experience in formal people management, including leading, coaching, and developing Product Owners or product professionals within a sophisticated enterprise environment.
  • The role requires proven experience in leading teams across various products or services, with the ability to build clarity, alignment, and consistency in delivery and product practices.
  • Candidates should have a consistent track record of leading central initiatives, influencing across departments, and delivering outcomes in environments where challenges span multiple teams or functional areas. They should be comfortable operating independently, crafting direction, and combining critical thinking with pragmatic execution.
  • Experience in portfolio-level product management is critical, including balancing short-term delivery priorities with long-term strategic value across multiple offerings or solutions.
  • This position demands demonstrated capability to drive adoption across large user populations, ideally in environments with 10,000+ users. It also requires improving effective usage through product thinking, change enablement, and engaging collaborators.
  • Strong communication, leadership, and influencing skills are critical. If you are able to independently persuade internal and external collaborators, often where priorities conflict, and build alignment around roadmap direction, investment decisions, and product outcomes.

Desirable Skills/Experience:

  • Experience with enterprise platforms and tools such as Jira, Confluence, Git Hub, Git Hub Actions, Git Hub Copilot, Jenkins, Sonar Qube, and Artifactory would be valuable.
  • Experience with cloud platforms, particularly AWS, is desirable.
  • Experience working in a regulated environment, including Gx P, would be helpful.
  • Experience leading AI-enabled product initiatives or defining AI strategy within enterprise platforms would be advantageous.

When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we fuel aggressive thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That's why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and bold world.

Why Astra Zeneca:

Here, platform decisions turn into real-world impact for patients. We bring surprising combinations of guides together to reinvent how data, machine learning and modern engineering accelerate discovery and delivery. You will shape the backbone that powers science at scale—working with leading specialists, pushing forward with a multifaceted operating model, and learning fast without compromising on doing things the right way. We value grit alongside ambition, coupling high standards with genuine support so you can take bold bets, see your work recognized, and grow your craft while improving lives.

Step in to lead the Dev Ops platforms within the enterprise that accelerate science. Take ownership of the portfolio and help us build the future of delivery.

GCL: D1

Introduction to ROLE:

Are you ready to secure a global SAP transformation and turn compliance into a catalyst for speed and scale? Join us to design the security backbone of a multi-country SAP program that underpins how we discover, develop, and deliver medicines to patients worldwide.

As a key technical contributor, you will shape robust, auditable security across S/4HANA, Fiori, ECC, BI/BW, GRC, and HANA databases—ensuring resilient operations and enabling faster, safer releases. You will translate complex requirements into clear, scalable designs that teams across continents can adopt, using automation and AI to reduce toil and raise quality. You will align controls and Segregation of Duties with a seamless user experience that accelerates the business!

Accountabilities:

  • SAP Security Architecture and Design: Define end-to-end security architecture for SAP applications and HANA databases, meeting functional needs while strengthening resilience and auditability.

  • Compliance and Risk Partnership: Work closely with risk and compliance partners to develop scalable, sustainable controls that remain SOx and audit compliant across regions.

  • Engineer role concepts and So D-aware designs that reduce conflicts and enable secure, efficient access at scale.

  • Lead Fiori authorization design, covering Pages & Spaces, app support, and unified launchpad for a secure, intuitive user experience.

  • Configure and handle GRC Access Control capabilities to implement preventive and detective controls and streamline access processes.

  • Plan and complete security activities for upgrades and transformations, safeguarding continuity while introducing improved controls.

  • Develop automation for repetitive tasks and leverage AI-supported insights to accelerate investigation, testing, documentation, and stakeholder updates, with human validation and auditability.

  • Monitor, report, and enhance manual/automated SOx controls; continuously evaluate simplification and automation opportunities.

  • Deliver clear, structured communications tailored to technical and non-technical audiences; engage business users and engineering leadership to align on requirements and outcomes.

  • Prepare security test scenarios, support test phases, perform cutover activities, and provide steady-state support that reduces risk and improves user confidence.

  • Provide architectural guidance that improves design quality across teams and drives consistent adoption of standards and guidelines.

Essential Skills/Experience:

  • In-depth SAP Security understanding & implementation experience in S/4 HANA & Fiori, ECC, BI/BW, GRC Access Controls

  • Well versed with foundational Security concepts across various business processes

  • Comprehensive knowledge of SAP role design considering segregation of duties (So D)

  • In-depth understanding of Fiori authorization concepts, UI/UX aspects with SAP Security Space (Pages & Spaces, App Support, unified launchpad)

  • Experience in requirement gathering, designing roles for hub & embedded deployment of S/4 HANA

  • Practical experience in configuration of GRC Access Control modules (ARA, ARM, ARA & BRM)

Job Title: Associate Director-Category supply planner

GCL : E

Introduction to role

Are you ready to orchestrate critical materials across a global network so life-changing medicines reach patients without interruption? Do you see yourself turning capacity constraints into resilient plans that keep service high and inventories optimized? This role sits above site, crafting how materials flow across multiple brands and suppliers, and ensuring our complex pipeline moves from molecule to medicine at pace.

You will lead materials planning for a sophisticated, high-impact category across a 3–24 month horizon, balancing global demand and supply while driving visibility, resilience, and performance. Working across internal manufacturing sites and external partners, you will deploy core planning processes, lead consensus forums, and turn data into clear decisions that safeguard our network. Your leadership will directly protect patient service, optimize working capital, and enable new products to scale.

Accountabilities

  • Ensure supply is secured in a 3 to 24 month timeframe. Optimize inventory and align with 0–13 week site plans to meet customer service levels.
  • Integrated Planning Deployment: Partner with global planning and internal sites to implement inventory design, forecasting, visibility, capacity planning, and scenario planning that drive network-wide decisions.
  • Critical Materials Consensus: Lead the materials supply consensus in line with the planning calendar, resolve exceptions, bring up risks, and ensure site plans reflect agreed solutions.
  • Network Issue Resolution: Lead resolution of supply or capacity issues at suppliers impacting multiple sites and brands; align with network planning to define scenarios for decision-making.
  • Global MRP and Capacity Forecast: Lead all aspects of worldwide materials needs and capacity projection for essential suppliers to direct supply commitments and risk posture.
  • Supplier and Site Collaboration: Work closely with critical suppliers and supply sites to maintain robust material flow, collate OTIF data, and set appropriate safety stocks for high-risk materials.
  • Supplier Performance Governance: Run a strong supplier performance cadence with weekly and monthly reviews to drive accountability and improvement.
  • Business Continuity: Understand and apply business continuity strategies; implement actions to protect supply of critical materials.
  • Network Engagement: Build strong links with the site planning community; lead regular supply and demand discussions to capture market and brand dynamics and reflect them in site forecasts and supplier S&OP.
  • Risk Identification and Mitigation: Collaborate with external operations leaders to contribute to supplier IRM, documenting risks and driving mitigations with suppliers and sites.
  • Constraint Management and Allocation: In constraint situations, develop network scenarios, secure endorsement from external supply leadership, and oversee execution of supply solutions and allocation across the network.
  • Inventory and MRP Optimization: Improve MRP parameters (lead times, safety stocks, consumption patterns); monitor signals, evaluate orders and due dates, and maintain healthy inventory positions.
  • Data and Process Improvement: Elevate materials planning processes, data quality, and MRP system performance to enable faster, better decisions.
  • Projects and Continuous Improvement: Participate in internal and supplier projects, applying Lean tools to simplify and standardize.
  • Cross-Site Influence: Collaborate across sites to manage shared critical materials and lead allocation in coordination with external operations and supply leadership.
  • Coaching and SME Leadership: Act as a subject matter expert and coach junior team members to elevate capability across the network.

Essential Skills/Experience

  • A degree or equivalent in Business, Logistics, Sciences or Engineering is preferred; equivalent experience will be taken into account.
  • 10+ years of prior experience in Supply Chain Environment (Manufacturing, Planning, & Procurement).
  • Proficient in complex supply chain planning encompassing inventory, capacity, and network aspects.
  • Capacity management & modelling.
  • Strong process improvement expertise and operational experience with ERP/APS systems.
  • Understanding of supply chain planning parameters, master data and master data integrity & quality is a must.
  • Strong competence in supplier contract T&C, SLA (Service Level Agreement), and MSA (Master Supply Agreement).
  • Experience in managing and developing solutions for supply chain events is needed.
  • Proven leadership and influencing skills in a cross-functional environment.
  • Experience in collaboration with key interfaces within the end-to-end supply chain, with manufacturing, supply chain, procurement and commercial functions – experience working with third-party suppliers.
  • Digital savvy (data & system minded), proficient in using key Lean tools, and excellent communication and collaboration skills to manage a broad range of internal and external partners.

Desirable Skills/Experience

  • Robust understanding of and contributing to an S&OP process.
  • Sophisticated supply chain (capacity and inventory) planning skills.
  • APICS/CSCP or equivalent certification.
  • Lean certification.
  • Leadership experience.

Why Astra Zeneca

Here you will connect bold science with disciplined execution to make a tangible difference for patients. We bring unexpected teams into the same room to spark new solutions, combining modern digital tools, Lean ways of working, and real-time data to run an agile, global supply network. You will gain hands-on influence across a complex pipeline, with opportunities to lead, learn, and experiment as we scale new modalities and smarter factories. We value kindness alongside ambition, blend in-person collaboration with flexibility, and back our people with investment in technology and capability building—while driving a sustainability agenda that pushes toward zero carbon operations and a carbon-negative value chain. Your decisions will directly shape how quickly and reliably medicines reach those who need them most.

Step forward to lead critical materials planning at global scale—take ownership of this opportunity and help us deliver more medicines to patients, faster!
